newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says Bandar Abbas refinery open in two months.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Bandar Abbas refinery open in two months.

text.p: Iran's eighth oil refinery, located in the Gulf port of Bandar Abbas, is due to come onstream within two months, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.

It quoted a member of the project's technical staff as saying the 232,000-barrel per day (bpd) plant "was almost ready to start operation" and would be commissioned in the next one or two months. It did not name the staff member.
The staff member said the refinery was equipped with storage tanks with a total capacity of 7.5 million barrels of oil, it added.

Officials have said the refinery would produce 46,100 bpd of gasoline, 36,200 bpd of kerosene and jet fuel, 69,500 bpd of gas oil, 66,500 barrels of heavy fuel oil, 7,100 bpd of liquefied petroleum gas, 5,000 bpd of tar and 124 tonnes of sulphur a day.
Iran delivered the first 60,000-tonne cargo of heavy crude oil to the $1.6-billion refinery project last month, they said.
Iran's current refining capacity stands at 1.24 million bpd.
